title: Study Evaluating the Impact of Mesh Pore Size on Chronic Pain After Lichtenstein Hernioplasty
brief_summary: The aim of the present study is to determine whether usage of mesh with larger pores, compared with mesh with smaller pores, would result in decreased rate of chronic pain after open inguinal hernia repair.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age ≥18 years
* unilateral primary reducible inguinal hernia
* elective operation
* consent to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \<18 years
* irreducible
* strangulated
* recurrent hernia
* inability to understand the questionnaire
* unwillingness to participate in the study
